aipconnect-aipconnect:lever:f57fa227-2d1.description: Our client is a multi-disciplinary engineering firm that partners with developers and landowners across Ontario to deliver turnkey residential and commercial projects. With deep expertise in urban & rural planning, civil engineering, architectural design and environmental sciences, our client is known for its strong technical coordination and rigorous project governance.
